ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible fluke area exhibits a ratio of approximately 55% low-intensity (black) pixels to 45% high-intensity (white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white blobs occupy the lateral-distal regions of both lobes. These are separated by a continuous, low-intensity black corridor spanning the central peduncle insertion to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 105 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude 'saw-tooth' peaks (approx. 5-7 distinct peaks) compared to the more rounded serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering toward acute tips, with a symmetrical inward sweep towards the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deeply irregular, jagged topography on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe tip, indicating significant tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine dark pigment mottling (speckling) distributed throughout the high-intensity white patches on both the left and right lobes.
